notes.title: MAGEYE's Future + Development Update
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello sightseers,[/b][/h3][p]Due to [b]some smelly circumstances[/b], I am becoming rather uncertain for this game's future. If you have not been [b]mindlessly wandering[/b] through [b]life[/b] as though in a haze you may have noticed a large amount of er... [b]silencing[/b] occurring throughout the [b]internet.[/b][/p][p][b]In relation to this[/b], I have not been revealing the full contents of this game for specific reasons and perhaps it is a good thing this game has yet to garner any sort of major attention prior to its release.[/p][p]The game's content is highly [b]controversial[/b], and I am bound to receive a few death threats for sure - I could not care less if I do. I am not going to quit development on the game due to previously stated causes, if anything this is [b]encouraging[/b] me to create this even more.[/p][p]Whether the game is [b]taken down[/b] or not, I do not think I could say I give much of a [b]fuck[/b]. You're all suffering with me. I'll continue working on this no matter the [b]cost.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Also... if you want to know how close the game is to being finished:[/b][/h3][p]I currently need to make [b]9[/b] more levels, add some more [b]NPCs[/b], maybe add a few [b]extras[/b] and do some other [b]monotonous[/b] dev stuff, then the game will hopefully be ready for [b]release![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cool vidz 4 magpie game!!!:[/b][/h2][p][b]Forgetting temporarily what I have said so that we may live without pure dread... [/b]here are some truly amazing, epic snippets for what's coming next! ;D[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yuDXDcyHNm0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="5gwWA9kR0ys;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]No goodbyes for you peoples.[/p][p][b]HONOR APATHY. (don't listen to it)[/b][/p]

notes.title: MAGEYE Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Hello, fellow sightseers!

I've made an update that adds a few a tweaks, some bug fixes, and an options menu that is now available when paused, which includes a much needed volume control. I send my deepest condolences to anyone who had their ears blasted off during your nefarious eye stealing.

As for the future, I have plans to add the option for other languages, and to release the game on Linux at some point. I am however currently prioritising completing the game right now, so don't expect this anytime soon until after the game is released. As for a release date, hell even I don't know when it'll be out. It's too early to say.

I would like to thank anyone that has played my demo, wishlisted the game, or just noticed my game in some form (even if it is severely fucked in places). Your choice to meddle within my monstrosities is equally flattering as well as disturbing.

Anyway... I need to get back work. Stay safe, and happy eye hunting!
